sql:
SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool) AS CharterSchoolCount
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool) AS NumberOfCharterSchools
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) 
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Direct';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Direct Charter';

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T2.FundingType = 'Direct Charter';
